title: a compatibility shim kept alive
question: Is a compatibility shim kept alive: an alias or redirect map, a fallback to an old format, a label that no longer matches its id, a deprecated option still accepted, code kept for old links?

explain.what: A model read the diff and found a compatibility shim kept alive: an alias, a fallback to an old format, a stale label or a deprecated option.
explain.why: A shim keeps two ways to do one thing; every later change must keep both working, and the old way never goes away.
explain.fix: Change every caller, link, test and doc to the new form and delete the old one. The second voice is in shadow: it warns only. Rate the finding (thumbs up or down) so its precision can be measured.

export const flagOf = f => FLAGS[f] ?? FLAGS[{ track: 'lane' }[f]];
